rawText:
Sarah Miller
Lead DevOps & Site Reliability Engineer
Austin, TX | sarah.miller@example.test

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Site Reliability Engineer with 7 years of experience provisioning multi-cloud Kubernetes clusters, orchestrating automated CI/CD infrastructure, and optimizing cloud expenditures using Terraform and Prometheus.

EXPERIENCE
Nexus Cloud Networks | Lead SRE
2022 - Present
- Managed production Kubernetes clusters running over 350 microservices across AWS and Google Cloud Platform.
- Cut annual cloud infrastructure expenditure by 31% through instance rightsizing and automated spot-instance scheduling.
- Directed incident management for p0 site outages, reducing mean time to recovery (MTTR) by 48% across the engineering organization.
- Architected centralized observability platform using Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry processing 50M metrics daily.

Vanguard Tech | Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
2018 - 2022
- Provisioned infrastructure as code (IaC) across 15 production environments using Terraform and Ansible.
- Configured GitLab CI/CD pipelines deploying containerized Go and Python services with zero-downtime blue/green rollouts.
- Implemented network security policies and TLS mutual authentication using HashiCorp Vault and Consul.
- Audited system security against SOC2 Type II compliance standards, resolving 100% of discovered vulnerability flags.

SKILLS
Cloud & Platforms: AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm
Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD: Terraform, Ansible, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions
Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry
Languages: Go, Python, Bash, Shell

EDUCATION
University of Texas at Austin
B.S. in Electrical and Computer Engineering (2014 - 2018)
